title: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
objective: Build a production-grade in-memory token bucket rate limiter in Go with table-driven tests and release notes.

epics.title: Requirements & Domain Modeling
epics.description: Establish requirements and Go interface contracts.

tasks.title: Extract rate limiter requirements
tasks.description: Extract rate limit parameters, bursts, replenishment rates, and safety constraints.

params.document: Goal: thread-safe token bucket rate limiter. Burst capacity: 100 tokens. Refill rate: 10 tokens/sec. Constraints: zero external dependencies, thread-safe, return errors on empty inputs.

tasks.title: Define limiter domain types and interfaces
tasks.description: Synthesize Go types including Limiter struct and Allow/Take methods.
acceptance_criteria: Compiles as valid Go without placeholders

tasks.title: Synthesize unit tests
tasks.description: Table-driven tests covering burst limits, refill rates, and concurrency safety.
